title: Example hotel booking slots
description: Reference booking slot schema for the hotel use case. Projects may substitute their own schema with VOICELOOP_BOOKING_SCHEMA or the schema_path argument of validate_booking. Cross-field rules (check_out after check_in, room type exists) are enforced in schemas/booking.py because JSON Schema draft 2020-12 cannot compare two date properties.

check_out.description: ISO 8601 check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD); must be after check_in.

room_type.description: Room type must be one of the room types known to the booking system.

contact.description: Optional contact details; email and phone are each optional.
